About Exponentia.ai

Exponentia.ai is a fast-growing AI-first technology services company, partnering with enterprises to shape and accelerate their journey to AI maturity. With a presence across the US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore, we bring together deep domain knowledge, cloud-scale engineering, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence to help our clients transform into agile, insight-driven organizations.

We are proud partners with global technology leaders such as Databricks, Microsoft, AWS, and Qlik, and have been consistently recognized for innovation, delivery excellence, and trusted advisories.

Awards & Recognitions:

Innovation Partner of the Year – Databricks, 2024
Digital Impact Award, UK – 2024 (TMT Sector)
Rising Star – APJ Databricks Partner Awards 2023
Qlik’s Most Enabled Partner – APAC

With a team of 450+ AI engineers, data scientists, and consultants, we are on a mission to redefine how work is done, by combining human intelligence with AI agents to deliver exponential outcomes.

Learn more: www.exponentia.ai

About the Role

We are looking for AI / GenAI Engineers with 3–6 years of experience in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience developing end-to-end AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Search, and API-based integrations. This role requires engineers who can take AI products from concept to production, rather than focusing solely on prompt engineering.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI/GenAI applications for enterprise use cases.
Build and implement RAG-based solutions leveraging LLMs and enterprise data sources.
Integrate AI models with business applications through APIs and microservices.
Develop and manage Vector Search implementations for efficient knowledge retrieval.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy.
Deploy AI applications in production environments and monitor their performance.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineers to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Implement security, governance, and best practices for enterprise AI deployments.
Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve deployed AI systems.

Roles and Responsibilities


Preferred Skills Mandatory Skills
AI Application Development
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Python
API Development & Integration
AI/ML Model Deployment
Vector Databases / Vector Search
Enterprise AI Solution Development
Production Implementation Experience
Good to Have
LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI frameworks
Knowledge Graphs and Advanced Retrieval Techniques
Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other cloud AI platforms
Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps practices
Machine Learning & Deep Learning fundamentals
Experience building chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, or agentic AI solutions
Candidate Profile
3–6 years of software engineering and AI development experience.
Proven experience building and deploying AI applications into production environments.
Strong understanding of LLM architectures, prompt orchestration, RAG, and vector databases.
Hands-on experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems and APIs.
Ability to independently design, develop, and scale AI applications end-to-end.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join Exponentia.ai?

Innovate with Purpose: Opportunity to create pioneering AI solutions in partnership with leading cloud and data platforms
Shape the Practice: Build a marquee capability from the ground up with full ownership
Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier talent and learn from industry leaders in AI
Global Exposure: Be part of a high-growth firm operating across US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore
Continuous Growth: Access to certifications, tech events, and partner-led innovation labs
Inclusive Culture: A supportive and diverse workplace that values learning, initiative, and ownership.

Ready to build the future of AI with us?

Apply now and become a part of a next-gen tech company that’s setting benchmarks in enterprise AI solutions.
